If a page later changes or vanishes, I'd want Keepwell to hold onto everything I saved — the title, my description, my note, and tags — and still try the stored address when I click it, even if the site itself then shows an error. The bookmark and my own notes about it are valuable to me on their own, so nothing should get deleted or rewritten just because the far end broke. And fixing the address myself being a later request is fine with me.
